summary: Two Palestinians were injured in two separate incidents when settlers threw stones at Palestinian vehicles.
discovery_sources: OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; NAD Daily Situation Report Mar 20 2023; WAFA 2023-03-20; NAD Daily Situation Report Mar 27 2023
resolution_notes: Unresolved-first recheck materially strengthened the Mar. 19 component: OCHA records one of the two vehicle-stoning injuries on Mar. 19 on a road near Ramallah/Nablus; NAD records a Mar. 19 evening stone attack on Al-Maarajat Road connecting Jericho and Ramallah that injured Munir Ahmed Abdullah Mur; WAFA independently reports the same named victim, masked settlers stoning vehicles, fractures/wounds and hospitalization. This Mar. 19 event-level lead is now independently corroborated and can be safely spun out without allocating OCHA's aggregate injury count by guesswork. The Mar. 27 component remains date/location-conflicted: NAD's daily report titled Mar. 27 records the Deir Istiya injury within a reporting window beginning Mar. 26, while its monthly report dates the incident Mar. 26 and OCHA says Mar. 27. Keep the package Unresolved until that second component is reconciled; do not merge by assumption.
media_status: No exact media recovered; no substitute imagery used.
